evals.prompt: Do a heuristic evaluation of these 4 screens of our money transfer flow (screenshots attached). Users are retail clients on iPhone.
evals.expected_output: A report that first lists the primary tasks, then findings each with location, heuristic, evidence, severity 0-4, confidence, impact and effort; missing error and confirmation states are flagged; findings needing user testing are listed; a note states it is a single-evaluator review.
assertions: Primary tasks are listed before findings
Every finding has severity, confidence, impact and effort
Missing states (error, loading, confirmation) are checked
